steps.message:
All files have been generated and validated. Here's a summary of what was built:

### Output Files (`/app/output/`)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Homepage (Stays) — 13 sections, ~38KB |
| `packages.html` | Flight + Hotel packages — 4 sections |
| `car-rental.html` | Car rentals — 8 sections with FAQ accordion |
| `attractions.html` | Attractions & experiences — 8 sections |
| `styles.css` | Shared stylesheet with design system |
| `main.js` | Shared JS for tabs, carousels, FAQ, search |
| `robots.txt` | Crawler directives + sitemap reference |
| `sitemap.xml` | 4-page sitemap with priorities |

### Key Features Implemented

- **Interactive tabs** on all pages (trip planner, popular links, car rental destinations, attractions regions/activities)
- **Carousel scrolling** with arrow navigation on unique properties and homes guests love
- **FAQ accordion** on car rental page (one open at a time)
- **Cross-page navigation** — consistent header with Stays, Flight + Hotel, Car rental, Attractions links on every page
- **Trust badges** with icons across all pages
- **Search forms** with basic validation
- **Responsive design** with mobile breakpoints
- **SEO package** following the `seo-local-business` skill: complete meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, canonical URLs, JSON-LD structured data (TravelAgency, Service, FAQPage schemas), robots.txt, and sitemap.xml

### Design System
- **Colors**: `#003B95` (primary navy), `#006CE4` (accent blue), `#FFB700` (highlight gold)
- **Typography**: Inter font family
- **Visual style**: Professional yet warm, generous whitespace, card-based layouts with gradient placeholder images
